trial_court: Family Court, Kasaragod (O.P.No.114/2014) and Family Court, Palakkad (M.C.No.94/2015)
facts_of_case: The parties are married but living separately due to disharmony. The respondent filed a petition seeking reliefs under the Hindu Marriage Act. The petitioner then filed a maintenance case. The child is with the petitioner.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking relief to establish the grounds for such relief.
